title: Piezoelectric Ceramic Cartridge for Impact Type Electronic Gas Lighters
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard deals with the general requirements and methods of tests for piezoelectric ceramic cartridge used in impact type electronic ( domestic ) gas lighters. ♦Specification for piezoelectric ceramic elements ( impact type and squeeze type ) for gas lighters. fRules for rounding off numerical values ( revised ). IS : 11514 - 1985
